levels.name: Awareness
levels.description: AI is discussed but no pilots or strategy exist; interest is ad hoc.

levels.name: Active
levels.description: Experiments and proofs of concept; knowledge sharing starts.

levels.name: Operational
levels.description: At least one AI project is in production with budget, ownership and supporting practices.

levels.name: Systemic
levels.description: AI is considered in every new digital initiative and is embedded in business processes.

levels.name: Transformational
levels.description: AI is part of the business DNA and central to the operating model.

ai_maturity_model.nist_bridge_note: The app's NIST maturity scorecard uses a 0–5 scale per subcategory; map 0 = not started, 1–5 = the five levels above.

ai_trism.name: AI Trust, Risk and Security Management (AI TRiSM)

layers.name: AI governance
layers.scope: Inventory of AI assets, policies, accountability, risk and compliance tracking

layers.name: AI runtime inspection and enforcement
layers.scope: Real-time inspection of models, applications and agent interactions; guardrails and policy enforcement

layers.name: Information governance
layers.scope: Data classification, access rights and protection of data used by AI

layers.name: Infrastructure and stack
layers.scope: Traditional technology protection: endpoint, network, cloud, identity, workload security
